wiki.summary: Rusty Intro is the opening track to HABIBTI — one of the two companion projects released alongside MAID OF HONOUR and highly anticipated album ICEMAN. The song sets a reflective and emotionally intoxicated tone for the album, blending regret, loneliness, lust, and self awareness over a late night atmosphere driven by club culture and emotional vulnerability. Read more on Last.fm.
